subject: agent://curia.example/tuesdaycrowd/scriptor
note: A log.operator-key entry whose jwk is in R6.62's closed form and whose point is not on its curve holds a position (on the curve is asked of a key when it must verify), and an attestation whose header kid names it and whose signature is 64 arbitrary bytes is act-signature-invalid, not act-key-unpublished. Statements are the exact output of CanonicalizeWithNfc, each signature is detached under curia-operator-act+jws with the key's thumbprint as the header kid; the keys the case publishes are its own log.operator-key, log.key and log.declaration-key entries. expected.json is written from this construction and never by running a verifier. A proposal: it may be regenerated until the owner's lift record pins its digests.
